pairs.target: dìèrhuí zǒujìn shòupiào wū , tǎ wéi méiyǒu xiān wèn liùtiān gòubugòu . tā bǎ xuégōng gàoshì shàng de rìqī chāo zài zhǐ dǐng , xià tóu kōng chū wǎngfǎn liǎng lán , děng qiántou de huòzhǔ wèn wán chuáncāng néng bunéng fàng huójī , cái dìjìn guìtái .
pairs.english: The second time Tavi entered the ticket office, he didn't start by asking whether six days sufficed. He copied the academy dates at the top, left outward and return columns below, and waited for the cargo owner ahead to finish asking about live chickens in the hold before passing his paper across.
pairs.hanzi:
第二回走进售票屋，塔维没有先问六天够不够。
他把学宫告示上的日期抄在纸顶，下头空出往返两栏，等前头的货主问完船舱能不能放活鸡，才递进柜台。

pairs.target: màipiào de nǚrén kàn le yìyǎn , rènchū le tā . " háishì yú wān ? " tā diǎntóu .
pairs.english: The ticket seller glanced at it and recognized him. “Still Elmbay?” He nodded.
pairs.hanzi:
卖票的女人看了一眼，认出了他。
“还是榆湾？”
他点头。

pairs.target: tā zhèhuí náchū de bān biǎo yǐjīng xiě dào lián xiū hòumiàn , yánàn shuǐ kuàng wú biàn , dìyītiān qīngzǎo yǒu chuán , dìèrtiān bàngwǎn dào .
pairs.english: This time her timetable extended beyond the break. If river conditions held, there was a boat early on the first day, arriving the second evening.
pairs.hanzi: 她这回拿出的班表已经写到连休后面，沿岸水况无变，第一天清早有船，第二天傍晚到。

pairs.target: huíchéng kě dìng dìsìtiān , tōngcháng dìwǔtiān dǐ tóng jiē chéngxià de kè bù , hái shèng yìtiān wǎng xuégōng zǒu . ruò wù le nà bān huí chuán , xià yìbān jiù bùnéng zhǐwàng ànshí .
pairs.english: He could book the return for day four, normally reaching Copperstep's lower passenger landing on day five, leaving one day for the academy. Missing that return boat meant the next couldn't be counted on for punctuality.
pairs.hanzi: 回程可订第四天，通常第五天抵铜阶城下的客埠，还剩一天往学宫走。若误了那班回船，下一班就不能指望按时。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ nàtiáo xiàn huà dào zhǐ shàng , cái fājué zìjǐ zài yú wān zhēnzhèng yǒu de yìzhěngtiān , zhǐyǒu zhōngjiān nà yìtiān . lùshang suàn chūlái de liùgè gézi , hūrán méiyǒu kànshàngqù nàme kuān .
pairs.english: Drawing the line on paper, Tavi realized he had only the middle day as a full day in Elmbay. His six squares suddenly weren't as spacious as they'd looked.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把那条线划到纸上，才发觉自己在榆湾真正有的一整天，只有中间那一天。路上算出来的六个格子，忽然没有看上去那么宽。

pairs.target: tā wèn néng bunéng xiān dìng huílái de wèizǐ . nǚrén shuō liǎngtóu kěyǐ yìqǐ liú , gǎi tuì yào gǎn zài kāichuán qiányìwǎn , háiyǒu yìdiǎn shǒuxù qián , chuán ruò tíngkāi zé zhào tíngkāi de bànfǎ tuì .
pairs.english: He asked about reserving a return place first. The woman said both legs could be reserved together; changes or refunds required notice by the evening before sailing, with a small handling fee. Canceled sailings had their own refund rules.
pairs.hanzi: 他问能不能先订回来的位子。女人说两头可以一起留，改退要赶在开船前一晚，还有一点手续钱，船若停开则照停开的办法退。

pairs.target: tā jìxià zuìhòu néng tuì de rìzi , méi zài wèn néng bunéng ràng chuán tì tā duō děng yíhuìer .
pairs.english: He noted the last refund date, without asking if the boat could wait a little longer for him.
pairs.hanzi: 他记下最后能退的日子，没再问能不能让船替他多等一会儿。

pairs.target: pángbiān yìmíng bào jī kuāng de fùrén tīngdào yú wān , tàn guòtóu láishuō tājiā wàishēng yě zài nàbiān , wèn néngfǒu shùnbiàn dài jù huà .
pairs.english: Hearing Elmbay, a woman holding a chicken basket beside him leaned over: her nephew was there too. Could he carry a message?
pairs.hanzi: 旁边一名抱鸡筐的妇人听到榆湾，探过头来说她家外甥也在那边，问能否顺便带句话。

pairs.target: tā chàdiǎn yìng xiàlái , tīngjiàn tā jiēzhe bàochū sāngè dìmíng , gǎnjǐn shuō zìjǐ dìyīcì qù , wèibì zhǎo dédào .
pairs.english: He almost agreed, then heard her rattle off three place names and hastily said this was his first visit; he might not find it.
pairs.hanzi: 他差点应下来，听见她接着报出三个地名，赶紧说自己第一次去，未必找得到。

pairs.target: fùrén shīwàng le yíxià , zhuǎnshēn qù wèn màipiào de . yuánlái tā yào zhǎo de rén zài lìng yíchù zhī bù , gēnběn búkào zhè bān kèchuán .
pairs.english: Briefly disappointed, the woman turned to the seller. Her contact was actually at another branch landing this passenger boat didn't serve at all.
pairs.hanzi: 妇人失望了一下，转身去问卖票的。原来她要找的人在另一处支埠，根本不靠这班客船。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ànàn sōng le kǒuqì , yòu yǒuxiē àonǎo , zìjǐ jìng bǎ jǐjù búhuì zhǎo lù dehuà shuō dé xiàng bú yuàn bāngmáng .
pairs.english: Tavi was secretly relieved, then annoyed that admitting he couldn't find his way had sounded like unwillingness to help.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维暗暗松了口气，又有些懊恼，自己竟把几句不会找路的话说得像不愿帮忙。

pairs.target: chū le shòupiào wū , tā zài shíjiē shàng děng sè lā . tā zǎoshàng jiāohuó , hái dé qù ná yìkǔn gǎi xiùkǒu yòng de jiù bù , liǎng rén yuē zài zhèlǐ pèngtóu .
pairs.english: Outside the ticket office, he waited for Sela on the stone steps. She'd delivered work that morning and still had to collect a bundle of old cloth for cuffs; they'd arranged to meet here.
pairs.hanzi: 出了售票屋，他在石阶上等瑟拉。她早上交活，还得去拿一捆改袖口用的旧布，两人约在这里碰头。

pairs.target: tā méi xiánzhe , zhào guìtái de shuōfǎ bǎ dìyītiān dào dìliùtiān zhòngxiě yíbiàn , tiān shàng kè bù dào xuégōng liú de yìtiān .
pairs.english: He stayed busy, rewriting days one to six from the clerk's explanation and adding the day allowed between landing and academy.
pairs.hanzi: 他没闲着，照柜台的说法把第一天到第六天重写一遍，添上客埠到学宫留的一天。

pairs.target: sè lā láishí , gēbo xià jiá zhe bù , lìngyìzhī shǒunázhe yìbāo chǎodòuzǐ . tā bǎ dòuzǐ gěi tā , shuō búshì chuánshàng chī de , chuán hái méi zuò , bié xiān bǎ yá èhuài .
pairs.english: Sela arrived with cloth under one arm and roasted beans in her other hand. Handing him the beans, she said these weren't for the boat; no need to starve his teeth before he'd even boarded.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉来时，胳膊下夹着布，另一只手拿着一包炒豆子。她把豆子给他，说不是船上吃的，船还没坐，别先把牙饿坏。

pairs.target: tā biān chī biān jiǎng bāncì , jiǎng dào dìèrtiān dào , dìsìtiān zǒu , tíng le yíxià , wèn tā nàxiē huó néng bunéng nuó . " néng nuó yíjiàn , bùnéng quán nuó . dāying de rìzi , yīfu dé jiāo . "
pairs.english: Eating, he explained the sailings, paused at arriving on day two and leaving on day four, and asked whether her work could move. “One piece, not everything. Clothes have to be delivered when promised.”
pairs.hanzi:
他边吃边讲班次，讲到第二天到、第四天走，停了一下，问她那些活能不能挪。
“能挪一件，不能全挪。答应的日子，衣服得交。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé gāncuì , méiyǒu tì tā bǎ nánchù tūn huíqù . tā yě méiyǒu zài wèn , zhī bǎ zhǐ fān dào piàojià nà miàn , zhǐ gěi tā kàn zìjǐ liú hǎo de wǎngfǎn qián hé éwài chīfàn de qián .
pairs.english: She was direct, without swallowing her difficulties for him. He didn't ask again, turning the paper to the fares and showing her the money he had set aside for both journeys and extra meals.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得干脆，没有替他把难处吞回去。他也没有再问，只把纸翻到票价那面，指给她看自己留好的往返钱和额外吃饭的钱。

pairs.target: fǎnxiào qián ruò chuán tíngkāi , yào xiān zhǎo kè bù chuánxìn chù , qǐng rén bǎ dāngē xiāoxī sònghuí tóng jiē , zài zhuǎnxué gōng ; búshì bú bào yìshēng jiù wǎng biéde lù luànpǎo .
pairs.english: If boats stopped before his return, he would find the landing's message office and send word of delay to Copperstep and onward to the academy, rather than dash off down other routes without reporting.
pairs.hanzi: 返校前若船停开，要先找客埠传信处，请人把耽搁消息送回铜阶，再转学宫；不是不报一声就往别的路乱跑。

pairs.target: sè lā tīngdào zhèlǐ cái zuòxià lái , bǎ bù fàngzài xī shàng . " nǐ xiǎng wǒ qù , wǒ zhīdào . " tā dītóu bāi yìkē dòuzǐ .
pairs.english: Only then did Sela sit, laying the cloth on her knees. “I know you want me there.” He looked down, splitting a bean.
pairs.hanzi:
瑟拉听到这里才坐下来，把布放在膝上。
“你想我去，我知道。”
他低头掰一颗豆子。

pairs.target: " kě nǐ yě búshì qù zuò yíjiàn bùnéng huílái gēn wǒ jiǎng de shì . " tā jiāng dòuzǐ dìgěi tā , shuō yuán xìn háishì fàng jiālǐ , zhī dài chāojiàn , bú dài zhe dàochù wèn rén rèn bu rènshi zìjì .
pairs.english: “But you're not going to do something you can't come back and tell me about.” He handed her the bean, saying the original letter would stay home; he'd take a copy, not carry the original around asking people to recognize the handwriting.
pairs.hanzi:
“可你也不是去做一件不能回来跟我讲的事。”
他将豆子递给她，说原信还是放家里，只带抄件，不带着到处问人认不认识字迹。

pairs.target: sè lā diǎntóu , ràng tā bǎ wū yà xiě de nà chù jiù dìfāng hé jīntiān xīn tīng de kè bù fēnkāi jì , biéjí qǐlái quán dàngchéng tóngyígè .
pairs.english: Sela nodded, telling him to record Wuya's old place separately from today's passenger landing, not rush and treat them as the same.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉点头，让他把乌娅写的那处旧地方和今天新听的客埠分开记，别急起来全当成同一个。

pairs.target: liǎng rén yìqǐ huídào chuāngkǒu . tā mǎi le yìzhāng qù piào , yòu bǎ huíchéng yě dìnghǎo , piào shì liǎngpiàn zhéqǐlái de hòuzhǐ , lǐmiàn yā zhe tóng hào de xiǎo qiān , qīng dé ràng tā juéde zìjǐ de qián hái méiyǒu huànchéng shénme .
pairs.english: They returned to the window together. He bought his outward ticket and reserved the return too: two folded pieces of thick paper with matching numbered slips inside, so light he felt his money hadn't turned into anything yet.
pairs.hanzi: 两人一起回到窗口。他买了一张去票，又把回程也订好，票是两片折起来的厚纸，里面压着同号的小签，轻得让他觉得自己的钱还没有换成什么。

pairs.target: tā fǎnfù kàn le biàn míngzì hé rìqī , cái shōu jìn jiá xìn de bùtào . nǚrén gé chuāng tíxǐng , qīngzǎo kāichuán , tíqián dào , bié ná xiū táijiē zuò lǐyóu .
pairs.english: He checked the name and dates repeatedly before putting them in his letter sleeve. Through the window the woman reminded him: early sailing, arrive ahead, don't blame step repairs.
pairs.hanzi:
他反复看了遍名字和日期，才收进夹信的布套。
女人隔窗提醒，清早开船，提前到，别拿修台阶作理由。

pairs.target: tā xiào zhe shuō jìzhù le . sè lā tīngbùdǒng zhège xiào , tā biàn bǎ shàng huí wù chuán nánrén de shì jiǎng gěi tā tīng , zǒu le hǎo yíduàn cái jiǎng dào zìjǐ dāngshí yě chàdiǎn xiān jǐshàngqù .
pairs.english: Smiling, he said he'd remember. Sela didn't understand the smile, so he told her about the man who had missed his boat last time, walking quite a distance before admitting he had nearly pushed ahead too.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑着说记住了。瑟拉听不懂这个笑，他便把上回误船男人的事讲给她听，走了好一段才讲到自己当时也差点先挤上去。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn huí xuégōng , tā bǎ xíngchéng jiāodào liúxiào wàichū dēngjì de zhíbān zhuō . lǎoshī kànguò wǎngfǎn bāncì , zhùchù nǐ zài kè bù fùjìn hé fǎnxiào yúrì , yī chánglì jìxià , jiào tā dìng le shíjì luòjiǎochù zài bǔ zài suíshēn lián shàng .
pairs.english: Back at the academy that evening, he submitted his itinerary at the duty desk. The teacher checked both sailings, his intended lodging near the passenger landing and his return buffer, recorded them as usual, and told him to add his actual lodging to the carried copy once settled.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚回学宫，他把行程交到留校外出登记的值班桌。老师看过往返班次、住处拟在客埠附近和返校余日，依常例记下，叫他定了实际落脚处再补在随身联上。

pairs.target: xiūxirì zǒu xiànxíng kè lù kěyǐ , xué guò jiè xìng bìngbùděngyú kěyǐ tì yántú mòshēngrén xiū dōngxī . tǎ wéi dāying , jiāng zìjǐ nà lián zhǐ zhé hǎo .
pairs.english: Current passenger routes were allowed during the break; studying borrowed properties didn't qualify him to repair things for strangers along the way. Tavi agreed and folded his copy.
pairs.hanzi:
休息日走现行客路可以，学过借性并不等于可以替沿途陌生人修东西。
塔维答应，将自己那联纸折好。

pairs.target: chūmén hòu , tā zhàn zài táijiē dǐng , wǎng xià kàn chénglǐ zhújiàn liàng qǐ de dēng . chuán háiyào děng yìzhōu cái kāi , tā què dìyīcì juéde , yú wān bù zhǐshì mǒu fēngxìnlǐ de liǎnggè zì le .
pairs.english: Outside, he stood atop the steps, looking down at city lamps gradually lighting. The boat wouldn't leave for a week, but for the first time Elmbay felt like more than a name in some letter.
pairs.hanzi: 出门后，他站在台阶顶，往下看城里逐渐亮起的灯。船还要等一周才开，他却第一次觉得，榆湾不只是某封信里的两个字了。
